rationale: DispatchSpec/ArgMode (the planned 'command dispatch' feature) have zero production consumers repo-wide; only tests reference them. The prior baseline flagged this as high; the codebase has since down-ranked it to a scheduled CUT via deprecation rather than reconnecting dead scaffolding.
proposed_change: Complete the scheduled deletion: remove DispatchSpec, ArgMode, and their tests after the grace release. No CONNECT — there is no live caller to wire.

rationale: Inert config field: it is serde-deserialized and stored, but no production code ever reads it — the only production touch is manifest.rs:198 assigning None. It exists purely so legacy manifests deserialize without error. This is form 3 (inert config) and is already covered by the DispatchSpec deprecation (sw-dom-1).

rationale: ValueObject is implemented only inside src/domain/skill.rs; no external crate/module imports or bounds on it. Its sibling markers Entity and AggregateRoot ARE consumed (src/memory/context/fact.rs, src/a2a/domain/task.rs). ValueObject has no live consumer, so it is either pure 'ubiquitous language' scaffolding or dead. This is a product/stylistic call, not a broken wire.
proposed_change: Either delete ValueObject (and its ~9 impls) if the DDD language is not being enforced, or keep it as intentional ubiquitous-language documentation. Do NOT reconnect — there is nothing to wire.
risk: Trivial. Removal is mechanical; no config/schema impact.

rationale: ParseOsError is constructed only by Os::from_str and surfaced only via its Display impl; the input() accessor has zero callers repo-wide. Hand-rolled Display/Error impls are more code than a #[derive(thiserror)] equivalent. This is the baseline's 'no external caller' finding, still true.
proposed_change: Replace the hand-rolled struct with a thiserror-derived error (or an opaque unit-ish error) and drop input().
risk: None — error is a local parse error, never matched by variant externally.

produced: SkillSource enum (referred to in scope as 'SkillDomain enum')
rationale: Verification of the explicit question: there is NO enum named 'SkillDomain' anywhere in the repo. The provenance enum is SkillSource, and it IS fully wired into the skill loader — NOT inert. guess_source() (mod.rs:699) derives it from the scan path, scan_directory() stamps it onto manifests, SkillRegistry::register() (registry.rs:32) dedups by existing.priority() >= manifest.priority(), and build_skills_prompt_xml sorts by priority (prompt.rs:251-252). The name-drift here is between the audit scope label and the real symbol, not a severed wire.
proposed_change: No code change. Record that 'SkillDomain' is a misnomer; the real symbol SkillSource is connected end-to-end.
verification: grep -rn 'SkillDomain' returns nothing; grep 'SkillSource' shows load-bearing uses in src/skill/*, src/builtin_tools/*, src/gateway/*.
